description: Search free CoreHu GPU machines in the live catalog, cheapest first. Each offer has an offerId (use it with prepare_rental when renting is allowed) and a rentUrl the user can open. Prices are USD per hour for the whole machine.

gpuCount.description: Number of GPUs in one machine (1–16)

gpuModel.description: Part of the GPU model name, e.g. "RTX 4090" or "H100"

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return (1–20, default 10)

maxUsdPerHour.description: Maximum hourly price in USD for the whole machine

minVramGb.description: Minimum VRAM per GPU in GB

name: search_offers

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, null if unknown

offerId.description: Offer id; pass it to prepare_rental to rent this machine

rentUrl.description: Page where the user can rent this offer in the browser

usdPerHour.description: Hourly USD price for the whole machine, default disk included

total.description: Matching free offers before the limit

title: Search GPU offers
